## About
Crone's Auto Body was started in Lakeside Park by Carl Crone and his wife Rita. Today Jerry Crone runs the shop as CEO, with Chad Crone as Production Manager, and the mission Carl set still holds: to provide those we serve with the highest quality standards.
Every car goes through the same steps: damage assessment, parts ordering, tear down, structural and non structural repair, paint prep, painting, then final assembly and clean up. Jerry or Chad handles the estimate and the final inspection. Master Technician Danny Purnell does the structural work, and Head Painter Mike Rabe lays down the finish.
We work with paint and materials from major, nationally recognized manufacturers including PPG, and we're rated 4.6 from 100 reviews on Google. As Jerry puts it, a safe car is what gets you home at the end of the day.

## Services
- Damage Assessment: A thorough inspection of the damaged vehicle, with the list of damaged parts entered into CCC Estimating Systems for accurate final calculations.
- Tear Down: A tech removes the damaged parts, then we inspect again for damage that wasn't visible the first time.
- Structural Repair: Master Technician Danny Purnell repairs or replaces damaged structural parts, measuring so your vehicle is repaired to factory specifications.
- Non Structural Repair: Body and mechanical parts replacement, dent repair and panel alignment, done after the structural work is complete.
- Paint Prep: Repaired and new parts are primed, sanded and prepped. It takes time, and it's what gets you a factory-like finish.
- Painting: In our Garmat or Binks paint booths, Head Painter Mike Rabe applies the finish.
- Final Assembly: Trim and moldings go back on, then the car gets cleaned inside and out and a final inspection from Jerry or Chad.
- Extra services: Pinstriping, door edge guards, side moldings, wheel opening moldings and glass replacement.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. We provide free estimates as a courtesy to our customers.

Q: Do I need to make an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates are written Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. An appointment isn't required, but it's a good idea to check ahead.

Q: How long will it take to repair my car?
A: That depends on the severity of the damage and the availability of parts.

Q: Do you have rental cars available?
A: We don't provide rental cars, but we typically partner with Enterprise if you need one.

Q: Will my car look the same after repairs?
A: We take pride in repairing vehicles to pre-accident condition. All repairs meet or exceed the manufacturer's specifications.
